The climate in Prague

Prague is about 250 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 26°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −2°C. Around 640 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in August (about 81 mm). The highest temperature in Prague in 2015–2024 was 38°C (26 June 2019) and the lowest −19°C (15 February 2021).

Best time to visit Prague

The most pleasant weather in Prague is usually in June, July, August and September: average highs are between 21°C and 26°C, with up to 12 days of rain a month.
